items.html: Now the Nefesh of Adam was from Nukva de ZA that descended in the place of Nefesh in Beria, and his Ruach was from ZA that descended in the place of his Nukva. In that, the text that states that Nefesh and Ruach are Malchut and Tifferet is correct and does not dispute with the article of Sabba, which speaks of after the sin of Adam.
